subject.title: [Feature]: Support strict integer validation in parseDurationMs

question: Should OpenClaw add a second strict-validation policy to the public duration parser without a demonstrated failing consumer?
rationale: Fractional parsing is an intentional, tested contract, so accepting this request would expand supported API behavior rather than repair a broken implementation.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Preserve fractional duration support and require any integer-only consumer to validate its own input boundary.

options.title: Add strict mode
options.body: Expand and document an opt-in policy across core, plugin SDK, and memory-host duration surfaces.

recommendation.title: Keep current contract
recommendation.body: Preserve fractional duration support and require any integer-only consumer to validate its own input boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and has repeatedly maintained the parser's core behavior and safety contract.
